description: This file provides centralized error handling utilities for a web application, including functions to extract error messages, normalize errors into a standard structure, and handle API errors with optional toast notifications.

methods.name: extractErrorMessage(error)
methods.description: Extracts a human-readable message from any error-like object.

methods.name: normalizeError(err)
methods.description: Normalizes any error into a consistent object with message, status, code, data, original error, and network error flag.

methods.name: handleApiError( err, { toastBus = (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.__toastBus) || null, defaultMessage = "Something went wrong", } = {} )
methods.description: Normalizes and optionally displays a toast notification for API errors, returning the normalized error object.

ctags.name: handleApiError
ctags.signature: ( err, { toastBus = (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.__toastBus) || null, defaultMessage = "Something went wrong", } = {} )
